decisions.reason: The compact dumper with rotating skip builds directly on the firm's established dumper and construction machinery know-how, so it can interpret early market feedback and refine the product with its own R&D.
The articulated construction dumper extends the firm's core vehicle engineering base, giving it high absorptive capacity to assimilate customer feedback and improve the product.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the firm's established offer, which weakens its ability to learn from early results, but its underground vehicle expertise and in-house R&D make continued development within the first year more likely than withdrawal.
The compact telescopic loader draws on the firm's existing lifting and construction equipment knowledge and service network, allowing effective learning and refinement.
